integrity: The proof supplies an explicit integer rank on every pair, proves that neither generator decreases it by more than one, and gives a word decreasing it exactly to zero. A standalone verifier independently computes shortest pair distances by reverse breadth-first search for n through 80 and checks the formula and transition inequalities.
scientific_limitations: The formula applies to unordered pairs in the classical Černý automaton. It does not classify exact weights for k-sets with k>=3. The abstract pair-weight spectrum already follows from the published extremal pair result; the contribution is the labeled closed formula and rank structure. Full text of Cardoso's 2014 thesis was not recovered through the bounded public-access route, leaving a residual originality risk.
title: Exact pair-synchronization rank formula for the Černý automaton
